case: genuine interactive on tty (expect interactive rc0)

writer.out: may own: the installed omp interactive agent

case: genuine + one arg value containing '--mode rpc' (expect admitted)

writer.out: may own: the installed omp interactive agent

case: genuine + split --mode rpc, pipe stdin (expect refused)

interactive.out: refused: a --mode run is a protocol or text role

writer.out: may own: a --mode run is a protocol or text role

case: genuine on non-tty stdin, writer open, no prompt (expect refused)

interactive.out: refused: standard input is pipe, not a terminal: omp runs this as headless print mode

writer.out: may own: standard input is pipe, not a terminal: omp runs this as headless print mode

case: installed bun running another script (expect refused; writer unrelated)

interactive.out: refused: the script argument is not a cli.ts in a src directory

writer.out: unrelated: the script argument is not a cli.ts in a src directory

case: installed bun running cli.ts outside omp tree (expect refused)

interactive.out: refused: the script is not in the omp package now

writer.out: may own: the script is not in the omp package now

case: foreign exe (/bin/sleep) presenting installed bun+cli argv words (expect refused)

interactive.out: refused: the executable is not a bun in a bin directory now

writer.out: may own: the executable is not a bun in a bin directory now
